name: Termex v0.80.0
body:
See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

## macOS Users

The `.dmg` is signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple — drag Termex to Applications and double-click to launch. No Gatekeeper workaround required.

## v0.78.0+ Note

Desktop binaries are now built from the Flutter stack only. The legacy Tauri/Vue stack is no longer published; existing users keep their data (shared SQLCipher DB).

name: Termex v0.79.0
body:
**第一个 Flutter 架构版本。** 桌面端自此由 Flutter 构建，不再使用 Tauri/Vue。

现有用户的数据会被保留 —— 两套实现共用同一个 SQLCipher 数据库文件，升级后服务器、密钥、配置都在。

## 下载

| 平台 | 文件 |
|---|---|
| macOS（Intel + Apple Silicon 通用） | `Termex_0.79.0_mac_universal.dmg` |
| Windows 安装版 | `Termex_0.79.0_win_x64_setup.exe` |
| Windows 免安装 | `Termex_0.79.0_win_x64_portable.zip` |
| Linux | `.AppImage` / `.deb` / `.rpm` |

macOS 的 `.dmg` 已使用 Apple Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，拖入「应用程序」双击即可运行，无需绕过 Gatekeeper。

现在 macOS 是单个通用二进制，不再区分 Intel / Apple Silicon 两个下载。

## ⚠️ Linux ARM64 用户请留在 v0.53.8

本版本**不提供 Linux arm64 包**。Flutter 官方不发布 Linux arm64 SDK，构建链路无法产出该架构的产物（旧的 Tauri 版本能提供，是因为 Rust 支持交叉编译）。

x86_64 的 Linux 用户不受影响。arm64 用户请继续使用 [v0.53.8](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/releases/tag/v0.53.8)，我们会在有可行方案后补上。

## 已知问题

- Windows 安装程序的**向导窗口图标**为默认图标（装好后的程序图标正常）。
- Windows 安装包**未经代码签名**，首次运行 SmartScreen 会提示一次，选择「仍要运行」即可。
- 应用内「检查更新」目前会失败 —— 更新源尚未上线，请暂时手动从本页面下载。

完整变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: Termex v0.53.8
body:
Maintenance release addressing bugs reported against the published build. No new features.

## Fixed

**Nerd Font glyphs rendered as tofu in the terminal** ([#17](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/issues/17))

The symbol fallback was only applied when the font's name matched `nerd font`. The Nerd Fonts project ships its patched fonts as `MesloLGS NF`, `FiraCode NFM`, `JetBrainsMono NFP` and similar, so powerline and icon glyphs fell through to the generic monospace font. Fallbacks are now always applied.

Custom font uploads accept `.ttf/.otf/.woff/.woff2`, but every upload was tagged as `font/woff2` internally, which macOS rejected. Uploaded fonts of all four formats now load correctly.

**Subgroups never appeared in the sidebar** ([#21](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/issues/21))

A group created via "New subgroup" was stored but never drawn, and a parent group holding no servers of its own was hidden along with everything beneath it. Nesting now renders at any depth, and a group whose parent was deleted is promoted to the top level instead of disappearing. The count badge reports the whole subtree.

**Key authentication required saving the passphrase** ([#21](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/issues/21))

An encrypted private key with no stored passphrase simply failed to connect. Termex now prompts for the passphrase and retries — on first connect, on manual reconnect, and on automatic reconnect. What you type is used for that one attempt and is never written to the database or the keychain.

**Clipboard copies from Zellij, tmux and vim silently failed** ([#19](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/issues/19))

Copying inside a remote multiplexer sends an OSC 52 sequence, which Termex accepted but then dropped when writing to the system clipboard. Non-ASCII selections (CJK, accented text, emoji) were also corrupted on the way through. Both are fixed, and terminal copy, the selection toolbar and SFTP "copy path" now use the same native clipboard path.

## macOS Users

The `.dmg` is signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple — drag Termex to Applications and double-click to launch. No Gatekeeper workaround required.

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md on release/0.53.x](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/blob/release/0.53.x/CHANGELOG.md)

body:
See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/zouwei/termex/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

## macOS Users

If you encounter **"Termex is damaged and cannot be opened"** error, run this in Terminal:

```bash
xattr -cr /Applications/Termex.app
```

Alternatively, download and run the `fix-macos-gatekeeper.command` script included in this release.
